_comment: The refusal case, kept in the sample rather than in a test, because the property being demonstrated is that the guest script never executes -- and only a real browser and a real server can show that. The refusal rests on the layout number alone: 99 is ahead of any client, while the design-system version named here is behind the client and is accepted. A segment this client has never heard of would be refused on the same path, and used to be claimed here without being present -- corrected 2026-09-13 when the layout version moved to 2 and this fixture had to move past it.
